item.text: The new shared view contract is verified. I’m removing the build output now and then I’ll summarize the design improvement.

Added a shared match-view abstraction in [KmpMatchView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/src/main/java/com/example/kmp/KmpMatchView.java:1). That unifies the read-only query surface for both a live matcher and a frozen result: pattern, text, match indices, counts, first/last match, containment, iteration, and callback-based enumeration now live behind one contract instead of being duplicated across classes.

[KmpMatcher.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/src/main/java/com/example/kmp/KmpMatcher.java:10) and [KmpMatchResult.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/021_kmp_pattern_searching/src/main/java/com/example/kmp/KmpMatchResult.java:7) now both implement that interface, so callers can treat them interchangeably when they only need match data.
